• Deep expertise in BLo C, clean architecture — not just familiar, but has enforced it

• Experience with large-scale apps (50+ screens minimum; 100+ preferred)

• Strong sense of code quality, reusability, performance optimization

• Capable of reviewing mid-level developers' code and providing technical direction

• Experience in fintech / trading / broking apps is a strong plus

title: PCG - Cat 2 - Dealing - Lead Client Acquisition - West
jobDescription:
Key Responsibilities

1. Business Growth & Strategy

  • Drive end-to-end business growth across client acquisition, broking, and wealth management (MF/PMS/AIF).

  • Own and deliver revenue, AUM, and client acquisition targets.

  • Formulate and execute strategies to scale wealth business and improve client penetration.

  • Identify new business opportunities, product innovations, and partnerships.

2. Client Acquisition & Revenue Generation

  • Lead acquisition strategy through RMs for prospecting, onboarding, and activation of clients. [Acquisition RM | Word]

  • Drive cross-sell of equity, derivatives, mutual funds, PMS, AIF, and other financial products. [Acquisition RM | Word], [Wealth Counselor | PDF]

  • Ensure growth in trading volumes, wallet share, and overall revenue per client.

3. Wealth Advisory & Portfolio Management

  • Oversee wealth advisory strategy, including asset allocation, diversification, and portfolio reviews. [Wealth Counselor | PDF]

  • Drive AUM growth across MF, PMS, and AIF products. [Wealth Counselor | PDF]

  • Ensure high-quality advisory support for RMs through structured frameworks and insights.

4. Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, mentor, and manage teams of Acquisition RMs and Wealth Counsellors.

  • Drive training, development, and capability enhancement across teams. [Wealth Counselor | PDF]

  • Build a high-performance culture aligned with business goals.

5. Client Relationship & Experience

  • Ensure strong governance of client engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

  • Guide teams to provide personalized financial solutions and proactive communication. [Acquisition RM | Word]

  • Address escalations and maintain long-term client relationships.

6. Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure adherence to regulatory, compliance, and KYC norms.

  • Assess business risks and ensure decisions are aligned with organizational reputation and compliance standards. [Wealth Counselor | PDF]

Qualifications & Experience

  • Postgraduate in Finance / MBA (preferred)

  • Certifications such as NISM, AMFI, CFA, or CFP preferred [Wealth Counselor | PDF], [Acquisition RM | Word]

  • 10–15 years of experience in financial services, wealth management, or broking

  • Proven track record in leading teams, driving revenue, and managing AUM growth

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of financial markets, wealth products, and broking ecosystem [Wealth Counselor | PDF], [Acquisition RM | Word]

  • Leadership and team management capability

  • Strategic thinking and execution excellence

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills

  • High ownership and result orientation

Success Metrics

  • Client acquisition growth

  • AUM growth (MF/PMS/AIF)

  • Revenue and profitability

  • Client retention and satisfaction

  • Team productivity and performance

title: PCG Cat 2 - Market Lead - Gurgaon
jobDescription:
Job Description

Ø Accountable for implementing an integrated plan which addresses wealth creation, wealth preservation and wealth enhancement for private clients achieved through an in-depth analysis of the client’s profile.

Ø Showcase entire product suite of Kotak Group to existing clients and growing their assets across Mutual funds, PMS/AIF strategies, Structures, Alternate Assets, Direct Equity, Unlisted opportunities and Consumer or Business Asset/Loan products.

Ø Deliver solutions to clients based on their investment profile in consultation with product & research team. Periodic review of client portfolios in accordance with established procedures and/or timelines.

Ø Proactively advise and consult with the clients explaining the types of financial services available, educate them about investment options and potential risks.

Ø Identify potential new clients and work with them to build up a relationship with the goal of managing their wealth.

Ø Achieve revenue objectives as assigned by the organization.

Ø Comply with KYC/SEBI rules, regulations, and legislation governing the financial services industry.

title: HO Ops - DP - Team Member - West - Corporate
jobDescription:
1) Vendor Billing Management

  • Own the end-to-end vendor billing cycle: invoice receipt, validation, coding, approvals, posting, and payment follow-ups.

  • Reconcile vendor statements, track accruals, and resolve billing discrepancies within defined TATs.

  • Maintain vendor master data, contracts, rates, and SLAs; monitor spend vs. budget and highlight variances.

  • Coordinate with Finance/Accounts Payable for timely disbursements; prepare aging reports and dashboards.

  • Partner with vendors to optimize billing processes, introduce automation, and reduce manual errors.

2) KRA / CKYC Knowledge & Execution

  • Perform KYC/KRA/CKYC checks during account opening; ensure records are complete, accurate, and regulatory compliant.

  • Validate client documents (POI/POA, PAN, Aadhaar, FATCA, etc.) and resolve KYC exceptions.

  • Interface with KRA/CKYC systems to fetch, register, and update client KYC details; maintain audit trails.

  • Support periodic KYC refresh/re-KYC, and ensure timely remediation of pending cases.

3) Trading Modification

  • Manage end-to-end onboarding: application intake, verification, document checks, data entry, in-principle approvals, and activation.

  • Process account modifications (contact details, segment enablement, nominee change, bank/DP updates, risk profile edits) with proper authorization.

  • Ensure seamless coordination with Compliance, Risk, Tech, and Sales for smooth go-live.

  • Maintain accurate system records, logs, maker-checker controls, and audit readiness.

4) Escalation Management

  • Act as point of contact for client and internal escalations related to onboarding, KYC, and billing.

  • Triage and prioritize issues, conduct root-cause analysis, and drive swift resolution within SLA/TAT.

  • Build preventive actions and SOP enhancements to reduce recurring escalations.

  • Provide status updates to stakeholders; publish weekly/monthly escalation and RCAs.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Domain: Strong understanding of KRA/CKYC, trading account opening processes, and brokerage/back-office operations.

  • Process & Compliance: Maker–checker discipline, documentation rigor, and audit readiness.

  • Billing & Reconciliation: Invoice validation, accruals, ledgers, vendor statement reconciliation, and variance analysis.

  • Systems: Experience with KRA/CKYC portals, back-office trading platforms, CRM, and basic ERP/AP modules (e.g., Tally/Oracle/SAP—nice to have).

  • Analytical: Data accuracy, pattern recognition, root-cause analysis.

  • Communication: Clear written/verbal communication; stakeholder and vendor coordination.

  • Ownership & Result Orientation: Meeting TAT, SLA, and quality metrics consistently.

  • Escalation Handling: Calm under pressure, structured problem-solving, and effective follow-through.

Job Purpose:

The Service Relationship Manager (Service RM) acts as the primary operational and service contact for clients, ensuring seamless onboarding, transaction processing, query resolution, and service delivery. The role focuses on maintaining high levels of client satisfaction through efficient back-office coordination, proactive communication, and process adherence.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Client Servicing & Relationship Management

  • Act as the first point of contact for all operational and service-related queries from clients.
  • Manage day-to-day client requests, including account updates, margin management, pay-in/pay-out, and reporting requirements.
  • Provide accurate and timely information on transactions, holdings, and reconciliations.
  • Ensure client issues are resolved promptly within defined turnaround times (TATs).
  • Maintain regular follow-ups with clients to ensure satisfaction and continuous engagement.

2. Account Onboarding & KYC

  • Coordinate with clients and internal teams for account opening, documentation, and KYC verification.
  • Ensure all regulatory and compliance requirements are met during onboarding.
  • Track and report the status of new account activations.

3. Operations & Process Management

  • Liaise with internal departments (Risk, Compliance, Accounts, Dealing Desk, etc.) to ensure smooth operational flow.
  • Ensure accuracy in trade processing, margin reporting, fund transfers, and reconciliation activities.
  • Monitor and manage pending instructions, unprocessed transactions, and client exceptions.
  • Support in audit, compliance checks, and process documentation.

4. Risk & Compliance

  • Adhere to internal policies, SEBI, and exchange regulations.
  • Ensure timely submission of required documents and reports.
  • Identify potential risk areas in client servicing and escalate appropriately.

5. Reporting & MIS

  • Prepare and maintain daily/weekly/monthly MIS on client activity, queries, and service metrics.
  • Provide insights and feedback to improve process efficiency and client experience.

Key Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong understanding of financial markets (Equity, Commodity, or Currency).
  • Excellent client-handling and communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and back-office systems (e.g., ODIN, NEST, LD, CRM tools).
  • Attention to detail and high accuracy in operational execution.
  • Ability to multitask and coordinate with multiple stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of KYC, AML, and regulatory frameworks.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, or Business Administration.
  • 0–2 years of experience in client servicing, operations, or back-office functions within financial services or broking industry.
  • NISM certification (preferred for capital market/derivatives roles).

Performance Indicators:

  • Client satisfaction scores and retention rate.
  • Service TAT compliance.
  • Error-free operational processing.
  • Process improvement initiatives.
  • Regulatory and audit compliance record.

title: IT Infrastructure - Data Centre Operations - West
jobDescription:
Infrastructure Monitoring:

  • Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure monitoring solutions using various tools (e.g., Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, Solarwinds, Motadata etc.)
  • Collect, analyse, and visualize data from infrastructure components (servers, networks, databases, applications, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain monitoring dashboards and alerts for proactive identification of issues.
  • Conduct regular server capacity planning and utilisation reviews, ensuring scalability and performance.
  • Collaborate with IT operations and application teams to define and refine monitoring thresholds and escalation protocols.
  • Analyse trends and historical data to forecast infrastructure needs and prevent potential outages.
  • Document monitoring configurations, SOPs, and incident response procedures.
  • Support audit and compliance requirements by maintaining accurate monitoring logs and reports.

Observability:

  • Understand and apply observability principles (logs, metrics, traces) to gain insights into system behaviour.
  • Implement and maintain observability tools and pipelines.
  • Use observability data to improve system reliability, performance, and scalability.
  • Expertise in Log analytics tools like Kibana & Elastic search etc.

Required Skills and QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Proven experience in infrastructure monitoring within a large-scale IT environment.
  • Proficiency in various monitoring, observability & log analytics tools (e.g., Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Solarwinds, Motadata, Kibana, Elastic Search etc.).
  • Experience with infrastructure components (servers, networks, databases, applications).
  • Familiarity with NSE LAMA framework.
  • Strong understanding of server architecture, virtualisation, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience in capacity planning, performance tuning, and availability management.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices, especially around incident and availability management.
  • Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Experience with automation and scripting for monitoring tasks

title: Risk & Internal Controls - Team Leader - Surveillance - Corporate
jobDescription: Generate surveillance alerts on daily basis based on parameters defined in surveillance process manual.  Analysis of surveillance alerts to identify the transactions of suspicious nature. Analyse client’s orders book, trade book, demat records to decide the transactions of abnormal nature and also to decide the action to be taken.  Sending mails to clients asking for relevant information to analyse the surveillance alerts. Coordinating with operations and IT departments for collection of relevant data required for analysis of surveillance alerts.  Analysing surveillance alerts received from stock exchanges. Replying to exchange letters and enquiries pertaining to surveillance.  Timely filing of exchange reportings related to surveillance.  Reviewing existing surveillance alerts parameters, surveillance policy and structure and recommending changes to the same for enhancing the quality of surveillance alerts being generated by the company.  Monitoring regulatory changes related to surveillance. Analysing its impact. title: Corporate - Chief of Staff - West
jobDescription:

•Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail

title: Depository Operations - Manager
jobDescription:
Responsibility-

1) Taking care of end to end process of client’s journey from Account Opening to Closure. Reconciliation of Franking/E-stamping and storage.

2) Well-versed with KYC guidelines of CDSL / NSDL, SEBI, and Demat Account Opening.

3) Responsible for managing workflow for the team and ensure adherence to departmental standards.

4) Coordinating with regulators like NSE, BSE, NSDL, CDSL and MCX to implement and adopt new regulations.

5) To work with senior management on audit and preparation of reports, Co-ordination and timely closure of audit.

6) Responsible for processing KRA and C-KYC for all the new Accounts and Modification.

7) Well-versed with the DP, Exchange Platforms, and Back office Applications.

8) Performing the due diligence on new Clients, requesting the KYC information, documentation, review and verification of received documentation and making an analytical risk assessment for new Clients.

9) Thorough and succinctly document the processes related to the KYC / AML / KRA & CKYC related activities, for an audience that includes Management, Regulators, Internal Audit & Internal Compliance.

10 Vendor management- ensuring effective, complaint, and efficient collaboration with third- party service providers supporting depository functions.

11 Ensure timely resolution of issues impacting depository operations through a structured escalation process.

title: Product - Team Leader
jobDescription:
Provide strategic leadership and vision for the design team, fostering a culture of creativity and excellence. Willingness to embrace failures and learn from them. Curiosity and passion for continuous learning and a receptiveness to candid feedback. High adaptability to change and being comfortable with ambiguity. Keen attention to detail, analytical prowess, and adept at managing multiple tasks in a dynamic setting. User Centric Design
- Ability to conduct in-depth customer research, analyse feedback, and translate insights into actionable product strategies. Knowledge of industry best practices in user-centric design and iterative development. Excellent communication skills to convey product vision, priorities, and objectives to cross-functional teams and stakeholders, ensuring alignment and shared understanding. Prior experience of leading/being a key member of a high performance design team in B2C fintech/ecommerce/digital startup is preferred. 10-15 Yrs of experience. With a major part being in UI/UX design

experienceProfile.rawText: 10-15 years

title: PCG - Cat 2 - VP - Projects
jobDescription:
Job Description: Vice President - Projects (Broking Company)

Position Overview:

The Vice President - Projects will oversee strategic and operational projects within a broking company. The role involves managing multiple initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals, and driving process improvements to enhance client satisfaction, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

Project Strategy and Planning:

· Develop and implement a project roadmap aligned with the company's overall business objectives.

· Define project goals, deliverables, and success metrics in collaboration with senior leadership.

Project Management:

· Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current systems and processes.

· Design and implement solutions to improve service delivery and operational excellence.

Stakeholder Management:

· Liaise with internal departments, including sales, compliance, IT, and operations, to ensure project alignment.

· Communicate project status, challenges, and achievements to stakeholders and leadership.

Regulatory Compliance and Risk Management:

· Ensure all projects comply with industry regulations and company policies.

· Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with project delivery.

Technology and Innovation:

· Drive adoption of new technologies to enhance client experience and streamline operations.

· Collaborate with IT teams to implement digital transformation initiatives.

.

title: Customer Services - Team member - Retention
jobDescription:
Job Overview:

As a Client Retention Specialist, you will reach out to clients who have submitted requests for account closure. Your primary goal is to understand their reasons for leaving, address any concerns, and provide solutions to retain their business. Your ability to empathize and resolve issues will play a crucial role in maintaining customer loyalty.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Outbound Calls: Contact clients who have requested account closure to discuss their experiences and gather feedback.

- Issue Identification: Understand the reasons behind the account closure requests and identify specific issues affecting client satisfaction.

- Resolution Strategies: Provide tailored solutions to address client concerns, aiming to resolve issues and encourage account retention.

- Documentation: Accurately record client interactions and feedback in the CRM system to track trends and inform future retention strategies.

QUALIFICATIONS:

- EDUCATION: High school diploma or equivalent; a degree in Business or a related field is preferred.

- Experience: 1 year in customer service or a call center role, particularly handling retention or escalation situations.

- Skills:

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.

title: Customer Services - Unit Manager - Training
jobDescription:
Job Role – Training Manager

Team Handling Must

1. Responsible for designing and implementing training programs that enhance employee’s skill and knowledge in Kotak Securities.

2. Assess training needs, develop curriculum and ensure that learning objectives align with the business goal.

3. Oversee training delivery, evaluate effectiveness and make adjustment to optimize learning outcomes for the in-house team and various outsourced business partners.

4. Developing and delivering programs through classroom instruction, online courses, and other learning methods for Inhouse and partners.

5. Evaluating Training Effectiveness for entire customer service functions – Inhouse and partner location.

Requirements & Skills

1. Securities background

2. NISM 7 / 8 certified preferred but not mandatory

3. Proven work experience as a Training Manager

4. Track record in designing and executing successful training programs

5. Familiarity with traditional and modern training methods (mentoring, coaching, on-the-job or in classroom training, e-learning, workshops, simulations etc

6. Excellent communication and leadership skills

7. Ability to plan, multi-task and manage time effectively

8. Strong writing and record keeping ability for reports and training manuals

9. Planning and Organizational Skills

title: Team Manager - Corporate Social Responsibility
jobDescription:
Assisting Head of CSR in day to day CSR activities and in particular but not limited to:
ü Identification of CSR projects in line with CSR Policy of the Company and finding appropriate Implementing Agency (IA) for implementation part
ü Conducting meetings with CSR project in charge/trustees/representatives etc.
ü Preparing project documents for Direct implementation projects in line with Schedule VII of the Companies Act, 2013 and Policy of the Company
ü Due diligence of the CSR project/IA before onboarding
ü Follow ups on documentation part (Compliance perspective)
ü Preparing & maintaining document for Releasing payments to Implementing Agencies and obtaining challans/35 AC/80G
ü First level Monitoring Implementation status of all CSR Projects – regular interaction with the NGOs to get monthly/quarterly data, project progress update, fund utilization
ü Arrange for monthly/quarterly reviews with the NGOs
ü On site inspection / monitoring of CSR Project of the Company and field visits
ü Maintaining records of documentation for CSR projects – Budget, DD Docs, payment release, receipts docs, project reports, fund utilization reports, MIS etc.
ü Tracking Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) for latest updates in CSR area and maintaining CSR Policy updated
ü Preparation of necessary docs for CSR Audit (Statutory Auditors, Secretarial Auditors & Internal Auditors)
ü Maintain coordination with various internal deptts for CSR related work – getting relevant data whenever required
ü Assisting in preparing annual reports, case studies, write ups, CSR website content and any other relevant details
ü Assist in various Group level & Company level CSR volunteering activities

title: Team Manager - Social Media
jobDescription:
Social Media

Grade – E1/E2

Years of Experience – 2 – 5 years of experience

The utmost role and responsibility of a reputation manager is to create and maintain a favorable brand image of the company and its products. He/she is in charge of every social media account of the company’s brands and monitors how the brands are engaging with the audience. ORM also handles negative publicity even on the review and rating websites.

Put Forth Company’s Best Image:

A company’s reputation depends on the way its customers, employees and investors view it. One tweet, one Facebook post, and even one review can influence these factors for better or worse.

ORM should put forth an image which conveys the message that the company values customer responses. This is achieved by always making sure you reply to the reviews, queries or complaints that the customer may have.

Expectations from ORM:

• Social CRM

• Social Analytics

• Regularly produce positive content for engagement with the audience.

• Have an understanding of search engine behavior, social media, forums, blogs, ratings and reviews, etc. These are considered to be the most important and basic skills of a reputation manager.

• Work towards enhancing and building the organization’s reputation by constantly measuring the effectiveness of your strategies.

• Establish policies and procedures, systems and standards that will avoid any negative impacts on the organization.

• Reaching out to dissatisfied customers is an important procedure to control negative reviews. Moreover, focusing on forums, tweets, images, and writing effective blog posts, or publishing positive reviews is also the responsibility of a reputation manager.

• Be well prepared for taking immediate action when the company’s reputation has been tarnished.

• Research online to find out all the negative keywords associated with a brand or individual and publish positive content that can then neutralize the effect of the former.

• Lead the management team in maintaining and improving the company’s reputation.

• Handle difficult situations such as internet blackmail and ethical manipulation of search engine results or reviews.

• Development of Positive Content, scheduled regular positive stories to build trust

• Engagement with the Audiences, based on positive attributes of the brand

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

• The ORM Executive is responsible for on-line content, tracking and analysis of reputation factors and account to successful management of Brand’s reputation.

• Facilitate problem resolution along with other questions.

• Consistently create an exceptional consumer experience with each contact via inbound / outbound post/tweet/email.

• Performing an in-depth audit of the information on the world wide web and ensure positive reputation of the Brand

• Continuously monitoring /Tracking the reputation of the brand on various outlets, e.g. social media, search engines, blogs & social communities, consumer forums, etc.

• Commenting positively on the most influential/negative forums and comments.

• Specialize in prevention and repair of the “Online Reputation Threats.”

• Understand the Level of the threat and analyze and manage Online Identities.

• Discuss and respond and continuously follow-up Plan Strategy and Implementation.
